description: This file contains an in-memory implementation of the IIdempotencyStore interface, providing methods to manage idempotency responses with concurrency control using concurrent dictionaries and task completion sources. It includes classes for entries and operation handles, methods to retrieve, create, or remove entries, and to mark responses as completed.

classes.name: InMemoryIdempotencyStore
classes.description: An in-memory store for idempotency responses, suitable for single-instance deployments and testing scenarios.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a store entry containing a TaskCompletionSource for ongoing operations and an optional completed response.

methods.name: TryGetCompletedAsync
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a completed idempotency response for a given key.

methods.name: GetOrBeginAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an existing operation handle or begins a new one for a given key.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the entry associated with a given key from the store.

methods.name: SetCompleted
methods.description: Marks an entry as completed with a specified response.
